customer_business: SFC Institute of Management and Technology

lines.name: Digital Marketing Service
lines.description:
Website audit, keyword research, competitor research, and technical SEO recommendations for the complete website.
On-page optimization covering page titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal linking, image alternative text, schema markup, crawlability, and indexation checks.
Content planning and monthly editorial calendar with topic clusters, search intent mapping, primary keywords, secondary keywords, and conversion-focused calls to action.
Four detailed articles every month including research, writing, proofreading, formatting, royalty-free images, internal links, and publication support.
Local SEO management including Google Business Profile updates, products and services, categories, business descriptions, photos, posts, questions and answers, and review monitoring.
Backlink research and outreach planning covering relevant directories, citations, niche resources, content partnerships, and link quality monitoring.
Technical monitoring for broken links, redirect chains, duplicate pages, canonical tags, XML sitemap, robots rules, structured data warnings, mobile usability, and Core Web Vitals.
Monthly reporting covering organic traffic, conversions, keyword movement, landing page performance, indexing status, backlink changes, completed work, and next-month priorities.
Social media strategy for Facebook and Instagram including monthly content themes, creative direction, captions, hashtags, scheduling guidance, and engagement recommendations.
Campaign planning for lead generation including audience research, ad structure, creative recommendations, landing-page review, tracking requirements, and weekly optimization notes.
The service description intentionally contains enough detail to continue across pages and verify that the generated PDF does not fail when an item has a very long description.
Additional implementation notes, review checkpoints, reporting expectations, communication procedures, and delivery standards are included for robust multi-page PDF validation.
